title: Matrix-induced linear map
statement: For a real matrix $A$ indexed by $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, let its associated continuous linear map on $\mathbb R^n$ send a vector $x$ to the vector whose $i$th coordinate is $\sum_{j=0}^{n-1} A_{ij}x_j$.
